changelog:
- Initial release of the auto-updater skill.
- Automatically checks for and applies updates to Clawdbot and all installed skills daily via a cron job.
- Sends a summary message to the user detailing what was updated or if everything was up to date.
- Includes troubleshooting steps, configuration options, and manual update commands.
